newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ISRAEL, Feb 18 - Haifa - Eight vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. Loading/discharging at berth, 5 general cargo, 3 containers, 1 passenger. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 1 general cargo, 1 bulk, 1 tanker. 2 Vessels under repair, 3 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to four days delay. Loading/discharging at berth, 12 general cargo, 2 bulk, 3 containers. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 8 general cargo, 1 bulk, 3 containers, 2 vessels awaiting orders. Eilat - Three passenger vessels loading/discharging at berth. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 1 bulk, 1 passenger vessel.

MOZAMBIQUE, Feb 18 - Nacala - Port working normally. No restrictions on berthing and sailing during night time. Draft restrictions, 9.5 metres at general cargo berths and 14 metres at container berths. One tug available. Beira - General cargo berths, working normally. Container terminal/other terminals, working normally, 24 hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 140 metres loa. Some restrictions for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. Maximum draft for 24 hour navigation 7.5 metres. Two tugs available. Maputo - 24 hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 120 metres loa. Some restrictions for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. All berths working normally and expected to remain so. Draft restriction in the channel is 9.0 metres less 0.5 mees (UKC) plus the rise of tide. Maximum draft for 24 hour navigation is 9 metres.
NAMIBIA, Feb 18 - Walvis Bay - Port working normally.

SOUTH AFRICA, Feb 11 - Richards Bay - General cargo berths, congested at present, berthing delays could be expected. Bulk import berths, fully committed. Bulk export berths (minerals etc.), some delays. Bulk coal berths, at present 4 vessels alongside, 14 at anchorage, 2 due 18/2, 19 due by 24/2. Durban - Container terminal, delays of 30 hours for some vessels, whilst others are berthing on arrival. Point, New Pier, Maydon wharf berths, working normally for general cargo vessels. One maize loader due in Feb. Bunker supplies fluid, however, this could change daily due to bunching of vessels. Drydock and floating dock fully committed until end of March.

East London - General cargo and combi terminal berths very busy, but no delays. Port Elizabeth - Working normally, no delays expected. Cape Town - No delays on container and general cargo berths. Fruit berths expected to be fully occupied in the coming week. No delays expected at bunker berths. Saldanha Bay - Working normally.

TUNISIA, Feb 15 - Tunis - Six vessels in port of which 1 discharging materials, 1 general cargo, 1 discharging bagged sodium, 1 awaiting instructions, 2 others. Rades - Four vessels in port of which 3 ro-ro, 1 discharging bananas. Goulette - North side - 5 Vessels of which 1 discharging wood, 1 cereal. 1 Discharging bagged sodium, 1 discharging steel coils, 1 passenger vessel. South side - 1 Vessel discharging grain, 1 in roads. Sousse - Five vessels in port of which 1 discharging pulp/reels, 1 discharging vegetable oil, 1 discharging general cargo, 1 discharging animal food, 1 loading bulk cargo, no waiting time. Feb 18 - Bizerta - Six vessels in port of which 1 each discharging sugar, timber, crude oil. 2 Discharging steel, 1 loading gas, no berthing delays/congestion. Zarzis - No vessels, no delays.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, Feb 16 - Dubai - Vessels operating from 9/2 to 15/2, 86 container vessels, 10 general cargo, 3 general cargo/container vessels, 2 bulk carriers, 8 car carriers, 13 tankers, 8 naval vessels, 1 livestock carrier, 6 bunkers/repairs/stores, etc., 1 dhow, 4 barges, 7 tugs, 18 supply boats, 1 lpg tanker, 1 vlcc, 2 passenger vessels, 1 bulk oil, 1 reefer, containers. 32 Vessels due, 6 loading at berth. General cargo, 13 vessels due, 3 discharging at berth, 2 under repair/laid up. Tankers, 7 vessels due, 7 under repair/laid up.

YEMEN, Feb 17 - Hodeidah - All berths are occupied. 8 Vessels alongside of which 2 bulk wheat, 1 each timber, urea, containers, 3 general cargo. 2 Wheat flour vessels waiting at anchorage. Berthing waiting time, general cargo up to 2 days, bagged cargo up to 4 days, bulk cargo up to 6 days, containers up to 1 day. Mokha - No vessels alongside nor at anchorage, no waiting time. Feb 18 - Hodeidah - Vessels berthed, 2 Bulk wheat, 1 flour, 1 urea. 2 Vessels awaiting berth at anchorage of which 1 flour, 1 yellow corn/soya. Berthing delays, bagged cargo 2-3 days, bulk wheat/corn 7-10 days.
